name: Swinging light headline
what: A dark headline waits in the dark while a small lamp on a thread swings in, a pull cord is tugged and the lamp switches on: the letters near it light up in a warm colour with a soft halo and follow the lamp as its swing dies away.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f34 the lamp on its thread is flung out to the left, swings through the bottom to the far right (f18) and back to the left; f39-f58 a pull cord appears beside it, is pulled down f39-f47 and let go f52-f58 while the lamp swings on (second left swing to f45); f59 the lamp switches on - white core, halo, the headline lit near it; f59-f133 the swing dies away (about -15 deg at f82, -4 deg from f133) with the lit part following the lamp; then it holds to f152

tracks.name: swing
tracks.what: the lamp on its thread swings from the left over the bottom to the right and back, twice more to the left (measured angle per frame), smeared by motion blur

tracks.name: pull cord
tracks.what: a short cord appears at the pivot, is pulled down about 11 px and let go

tracks.name: light on
tracks.what: the lamp switches on: white core, warm halo, the letters near it lit

tracks.name: swing dies away
tracks.what: the lamp keeps swinging, smaller and smaller; the lit part of the headline follows it

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the lamp hangs still, the headline lit around it
